user.title: Configure Loggy AI
user.description:
Set up your AI-powered log analyzer. Get API keys from:
• Gemini: https://aistudio.google.com/apikey
• OpenAI: https://platform.openai.com/api-keys
• Anthropic: https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys

error.invalid_api_key: Invalid API key. Please check your key and try again.
error.connection_error: Unable to connect to AI provider. Check your internet connection.
error.invalid_response: Received invalid response from AI provider.
error.log_file_not_found:
Log file not found at the specified path. Common locations:
• Docker/HA OS: /config/home-assistant.log
• Supervised: /config/home-assistant.log
• Core: ~/.homeassistant/home-assistant.log

Please verify the path exists and is accessible.

abort.already_configured: This API key is already configured.
